items.title: Solana’s plan to cut account deposits by 90% could weaken a reason to hold SOL
items.whyYouShouldCare: Reducing account deposits by 90% may diminish the utility of holding SOL, impacting its demand and overall market positioning.

items.title: Solana’s rent reform could free 3.08M SOL – But is it really an ‘airdrop’?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The potential release of 3.08 million SOL through rent reform could influence market liquidity, but its classification as an 'airdrop' remains debatable.

items.title: UBS, Jane Street among firms with combined $75 million in Hyperliquid ETF holdings: Bloomberg
items.whyYouShouldCare: The involvement of major firms like UBS and Jane Street in Hyperliquid ETF holdings indicates growing institutional interest, which could enhance Solana's ecosystem credibility.
